title: Certificates for Computer-assisted Morse indices of nonmagnetic Ginzburg-Landau vortices of degrees four through eight
description: CERTIFIED exact-rational finite certificates for conditional full-plane indices 12,20,30,36,48 at degrees 4,5,6,7,8. The conjectured n(n-1) upper bound is attained at 4,5,6 and strictly non-sharp at 7,8, not refuted. Bounded-kernel nondegeneracy is claimed only at degree four. The analytic spectral inputs and written variational bridge are not formalised in Lean. Lean checks degree-four polynomial statements and 15 of the 97 higher-degree files (96 generated integer-list modules plus the root import file); the remainder are not machine-checked. Tail5M2 was accepted only with a 10000 MB kernel allowance rather than the earlier 5000 MB limit; the shipped higher-degree lakefile now uses 10000 MB. No full higher-degree certificate-chain theorem or experimental result is claimed. AI agents generated proofs, certificates, code, Lean sources and manuscript drafts and edits under D. Rens's direction and review.
